findings.note: last-pass-fresh porcelain refuse is a machine gate (RESULT:MET/NOT_MET). Landmine is ASSERT:PASS/FAIL. Docs name the same stop predicate.
Extends an existing fitness binder. No new pin, sidecar, hook, verifier, registry, or trusted-key list. Planit SKILL.md is not edited so the identity registry is not rewritten.
Scope is the RCA one thing: hub verify NOT_MET unless git status --porcelain is empty. Not a regen checklist. Not hashing untracked files into the digest.
gitignore .nlc/planit-in-progress.json so a live Planit session can prove a clean HEAD. Porcelain already omits gitignored paths.
PROCESS.md and VERIFY-AND-SHIP document the gate. Planit SKILL.md stays unedited to avoid planit-skill-registry pin churn.
No merge to main, no ./release, no nlc-version bump.
Tightens existing hub verify around ADR 0050 content freshness. No new noun, verb, or charter rule. No new ADR.
